record.reason: The paper uses contrastive learning to improve post-training quantization calibration and evaluates vision models. It is a concrete quantization method, but evidence is vision-only and does not establish gains for language-model inference.
record.title: Enhancing Post-Training Quantization Calibration Through Contrastive Learning
